children.name: VMware ULM - Frequent Virtual Machine Power Offs

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 AND ("is powered off" OR "is suspended") 
 | parse "vm=*,,,host=*" as vm, esx_host 
 | count by vm, esx_host 
 | where _count >=3

children.name: VMware ULM - Multiple Virtual Machines stopped

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 AND ("is powered off" OR "is suspended") 
 | parse "vm=*,,,host=*" as vm, esx_host 
 | count by vm, esx_host 
 | count by esx_host 
 | where _count >=3

children.name: VMware ULM - Summary of vCenter Alarms

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and "VmCreatedEvent" or "VmClonedEvent" 
| parse "user=*,,,eventType=*,,,vm=*,,,host=*,,,datacenter=*,,,computeResource=*,,,key=*,,,chainId=*" as user, event_type, vm, host, datacenter, cluster, key, chainid

children.name: VMware ULM - Virtual Machine Creations and Deletions over Time

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 ( "VmCreatedEvent" or "VmClonedEvent" or "VmRemovedEvent") 
| parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type 
| if (event_type matches "*VmCreatedEvent*" or event_type matches "*VmClonedEvent*", 1,0) as creations | if (event_type matches "*VmRemovedEvent*", 1,0) as deletions |  timeslice by 1h | sum(creations) as creations, sum(deletions) as deletions by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 "VmRemovedEvent" 
| parse "user=*,,,eventType=*,,,vm=*,,,host=*,,,datacenter=*,,,computeResource=*,,,key=*,,,chainId=*" as user, event_type, vm, host, datacenter, cluster, key, chainid

children.name: VMware ULM - Virtual Machine Errors - Analysis

panels.name: Top 10 VM's facing Errors
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("error" or "fail" or "critical")
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host 
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm 
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}} and vm matches {{vm}}
 | count_frequent vm
 | limit 10

panels.name: Primary VM Failures by ESXi Hosts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmPrimaryFailoverEvent")
 | parse "message=*,,," as err_msg
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | count by esx_host
 | sort by _count 
 | limit 10

panels.name: VM Upgrade Failures by ESXi Hosts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmUpgradeFailedEvent")
 | parse "message=*,,," as err_msg
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | count by esx_host
 | sort by _count 
 | limit 10

panels.name: VM Fault Tolerance Errors
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmDasUpdateErrorEvent" or "VmSecondaryDisabledBySystemEvent")
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host 
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | if(event_type matches "*VmDasUpdateErrorEvent*","HA Agent Update Failed",event_type) as ha_conflict_type 
 | if(event_type matches "*VmSecondaryDisabledBySystemEvent*","Fault Tolerance Disabled",event_type) as mac_conflict_type
 | timeslice 1h
 | count(ha_conflict_type) as ha_agent_failure, count(mac_conflict_type) as fault_tolerance_disabled by _timeslice
 | compare with timeshift 1d 7

panels.name: VM Power Off Failures
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmFailedToPowerOffEvent")
 | parse "message=*,,," as err_msg
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | timeslice by 1d
 | count by esx_host, _timeslice
 | transpose row _timeslice column esx_host

panels.name: VM Power On Failures
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmFailedToPowerOnEvent")
 | parse "message=*,,," as err_msg
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}} 
 | timeslice by 1d
 | count by esx_host, _timeslice
 | transpose row _timeslice column esx_host

panels.name: General VM Errors
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("GeneralVmErrorEvent")
 | parse "message=*,,," as err_msg
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | count by esx_host, vm, err_msg, _messageTime
 | fields - _messageTime
 | fields - _count

panels.name: VM Mac Address and UUID Conflicts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmInstanceUuidConflictEvent" or "VmMacConflictEvent")
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host 
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm 
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | if(event_type matches "*VmInstanceUuidConflictEvent*","Uuid Conflict","") as conflict_type 
 | if(event_type matches "*VmMacConflictEvent*","Mac Address Conflict",conflict_type) as conflict_type
 | timeslice 15m
 | count conflict_type, _timeslice
 | transpose row _timeslice column conflict_type

panels.name: vSphere Errors Across Clusters
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("error" or "fail" or "critical")
 | parse "message=*,,," as err_msg
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host nodrop
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | timeslice 15m
 | count(err_msg) by _timeslice, cluster
 | transpose row _timeslice column cluster as *

panels.name: Virtual Machine Operations Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmCreatedEvent" OR "VmClonedEvent" OR ("VmMigratedEvent") OR ("VmRemovedEvent"))
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type 
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host nodrop
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 |  timeslice by 1d
 | if(event_type matches "*VmCreatedEvent*" OR event_type matches "*VmClonedEvent*",1,0) as creations 
 | if(event_type matches "*VmMigratedEvent*",1,0) as migrations
 | if(event_type matches "*VmRemovedEvent*" ,1,0) as deletions
 | sum(creations) as creations,sum(deletions) as deletions,sum(migrations) as migrations by _timeslice
 | sort _timeslice asc

panels.name: vCenter Alarms
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and "AlarmStatusChangedEvent"
 | parse "message=Alarm '*' on * changed from * to *,,," as alarm_mesg,hostname,old_status,new_status
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host nodrop
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type nodrop
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm nodrop
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | timeslice 5m 
 | count as count by _timeslice,alarm_mesg
 | transpose row _timeslice column alarm_mesg as *

panels.name: Most Active Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and "user="
| parse ",,,user=*,,," as user
| where  user !=""
| count  by user
| sort by _count
| limit 10

panels.name: vCenter User Activity
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5
 | parse regex "(?:message=User)\s(?<user>.*?)\s(?<task>logged out|logged in|.*)(?:\s.*,,,)"
 | where  user !=""
 | timeslice 5m 
 | count as count by _timeslice,task
 | transpose row _timeslice column task as *

panels.name: Virtual Machine Operations by User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("VmCreatedEvent" OR "VmClonedEvent" OR ("VmMigratedEvent")  OR ("VmRemovedEvent"))
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type
 | if(event_type matches "*VmCreatedEvent*" OR event_type matches "*VmClonedEvent*","creations","") as type 
 | if(event_type matches "*VmMigratedEvent*","migrations",type) as type
 | if(event_type matches "*VmRemovedEvent*","deletions",type) as type
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "user=*,,," as user
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm 
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}}
 | count by user,type
 | transpose row user column type

panels.name: Infrastructure Summary
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}} and vm matches {{vm}} and cluster matches {{cluster}}
 | count_distinct(vm)  as vm_count by esx_host, cluster

panels.name: ESXi Hosts per Cluster
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}} and cluster matches {{cluster}}
 | count_distinct(esx_host)  as host_count by cluster

panels.name: VM with Failures per ESXi Host
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/VMWare6.5 and ("error" or "fail" or "critical")
 | parse "eventType=*,,," as event_type
 | parse "host=*,,," as esx_host 
 | parse "vm=*,,," as vm 
 | parse "computeResource=*,,," as cluster nodrop
 | where esx_host matches {{esx_host}} and vm matches {{vm}}
 | count(vm) as vm_with_failures_count by esx_host
